#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Convert the legacy fixed-width warehouse feed to CSV."""

import csv
import os
import sys

RECORD_WIDTH = 21
ID_END = 5
NAME_END = 17


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        sys.stderr.write("usage: {} INPUT\n".format(sys.argv[0]))
        return 2

    rejects_path = os.path.join(
        os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))),
        "rejects.txt",
    )
    writer = csv.writer(sys.stdout, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(("id", "name", "quantity"))

    with open(sys.argv[1], "r", encoding="ascii", newline="") as source, \
            open(rejects_path, "w", encoding="ascii", newline="") as rejects:
        for line_number, raw_line in enumerate(source, 1):
            record = raw_line[:-1] if raw_line.endswith("\n") else raw_line
            if len(record) != RECORD_WIDTH:
                rejects.write("{}: {}\n".format(line_number, record))
                continue

            record_id = record[:ID_END]
            name = record[ID_END:NAME_END].rstrip(" ")
            quantity_text = record[NAME_END:]
            if not all("0" <= character <= "9" for character in quantity_text):
                rejects.write("{}: {}\n".format(line_number, record))
                continue

            writer.writerow((record_id, name, int(quantity_text)))

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
